c27.display: Predict: it gives a chance to every possible next token.

c28.display: Pick: it chooses one of the likely ones.

c30.display: Repeat: then it reads everything again, including what it just wrote, and predicts the next token. Over and over, until the answer is done.

c31.display: That loop explains something you've probably noticed: answers appear word by word.
